questions.q: Can you bid from architect's plans?
questions.a: Yes. General contractors send us drawings and specs every week. We bid from the plans, then produce shop drawings and submittals for approval before anything is cut.

questions.q: Do you install, or just build?
questions.a: Both. Our own crew installs everything we build, including countertops, and handles the punch list with you at the end.
Commercial is our focus. We do take on multifamily projects for builders and general contractors. For a single-family home, give us a call and we'll tell you straight whether we're the right fit.
